# defectdojo_location (Data Source)

Data source for a DefectDojo Location. Locations are the read-only polymorphic base of URL and network locations in DefectDojo 3.x: the `/api/v2/location/` API only supports GET, so this data source cannot create or manage locations. Manage `defectdojo_url` or `defectdojo_network_location` resources instead; a location's id matches the id of the concrete resource it backs (e.g. a `defectdojo_url` resource's id is also its location id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_location" "example" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier. This is the only supported lookup key: the locations API has no name-based filter.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Time that the object was initially created, and saved to the database.
- `inherited_tags` (Set of String) Tags inherited by the location from related objects.
- `location_type` (String) The type of location that is stored, e.g. "URL" for HTTP(S) locations managed via `defectdojo_url`, or a network location type. This is a polymorphic discriminator that DefectDojo manages automatically.
- `location_value` (String) The string representation of the location, automatically managed by DefectDojo.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the location.
- `updated` (String) Time that the object was most recently saved to the database.
